lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਇ ਬੈਸਿ ਧੂਪੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਦੂਧੈ ਕਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaa(n)daa dhoi bais dhoop devahu tau doodhai kau jaavahu ||
lines.translation: Wash the vessel, sit down and anoint it with fragrance; then, go out and get the milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਜਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: doodh karam phun surat samaain hoi niraas jamaavahu ||1||
lines.translation: Add the rennet of clear consciousness to the milk of good deeds, and then, free of desire, let it curdle. ||1||
Chant the Name of the One Lord.
All other actions are fruitless. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਈਟੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man eetee haath karahu phun netrau need na aavai ||
lines.translation: Let your mind be the handles, and then churn it, without sleeping.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਬ ਮਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa naam japahu tab matheeai in bidh a(n)mrit paavahu ||2||
lines.translation: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord ,with your tongue, then the curd will be churned. In this way, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਵਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sa(n)pat jit sat sar naavan bhaavan paatee tripat kare ||
lines.translation: Wash your mind in the pool of Truth, and let it be the vessel of the Lord; let this be your offering to please Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa praan sevak je seve inh bidh saahib ravat rahai ||3||
lines.translation: That humble servant who dedicates and offers his life, and who serves in this way, remains absorbed in his Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahade kahahi kahe kahi jaavahi tum sar avar na koee ||
lines.translation: The speakers speak and speak and speak, and then they depart. There is no other to compare to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਹਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat heen naanak jan ja(n)pai hau saalaahee sachaa soee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak, lacking devotion, humbly prays: may I sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||4||1||
Soohee, First Mehl, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Deep within the self, the Lord abides; do not go outside looking for Him.
You have renounced the Ambrosial Nectar - why are you eating poison? ||1||
Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my mind,
and become the slave of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
Everyone speaks of wisdom and meditation;
but bound in bondage, the whole world is wandering around in confusion. ||2||
One who serves the Lord is His servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa soi ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਚੰਗੇ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham nahee cha(n)ge buraa nahee koi ||
lines.translation: I am not good; no one is bad.
Prays Nanak, He alone saves us! ||4||1||2||
